details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:309-360 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: subprocess.run(..., text=True, timeout=SEMBLE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECS) can raise UnicodeDecodeError on non-UTF-8 Semble output, and the current except clause does not catch it.
  WHY: Reviewers agree the decode error propagates out of _run_semble_query and bypasses the marker/read fallback, crashing emit_context.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:416-520 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The extended summary breakdown omits missing and binary file categories, so the displayed category totals do not sum to Included.
  WHY: The reviewers reported that missing/binary entries increment included but are not represented in the extended breakdown; some described it as pre-existing/non-critical, but the mismatch is still present.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:569-572 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: _read_optional_query_text(args.plan_file) rereads --plan-file even though plan_text was already loaded.
  WHY: Reviewers agree this causes redundant I/O and parsing on the same file.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:400-427 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The test patches Path.read_bytes, but the read-fallback path uses abs_path.open("rb") and handle.read() instead.
  WHY: The mock does not intercept the API used by the code path it is meant to guard, so regressions there can slip by.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:429-463 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: _append_semble_block/_append_read_fallback_block return only chunk/body byte counts, not the header/footer bytes they add to the prompt.
  WHY: The source itself notes this is internally consistent with the non-overflow path and not a traditional correctness bug, so this is a low-confidence observation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:333-339 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: subprocess.run(..., text=True, timeout=SEMBLE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECS) can raise UnicodeDecodeError on invalid UTF-8 Semble output, and the except clause only catches OSError and subprocess.TimeoutExpired.
  WHY: The uncaught decode error propagates out of _run_semble_query and prevents the fallback path from running.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:429-435,462-463 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: _append_semble_block/_append_read_fallback_block return only chunk/body byte counts, so the rendered-bytes accounting does not include the block overhead they add to the prompt.
  WHY: The source notes the same accounting style is used on the non-overflow path, making this a low-confidence observation rather than a clear correctness bug.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:~327-339 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: subprocess.run uses text=True but the exception handler only catches OSError and subprocess.TimeoutExpired, so UnicodeDecodeError from non-UTF-8 output escapes _run_semble_query.
  WHY: The uncaught decode error crashes emit_context instead of falling back to marker/read mode.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:~400-427 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test patches Path.read_bytes, but the code path under test uses abs_path.open("rb") and handle.read() instead.
  WHY: The patch won't intercept the file-read API used by the read-fallback path, so regressions there can slip past the test.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:334 | confidence=5

  WHY: subprocess.run(..., text=True, ...) can raise a decode error that escapes the except clause and crashes emit_context instead of falling back.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:416, 480, 497-509 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Extended summary breakdown omits missing and binary file categories.
  WHY: Missing and binary files increment included but have no corresponding category in the extended summary breakdown, so the per-category totals do not sum to the reported included count.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:572 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Redundant re-reading of --plan-file.
  WHY: plan_text is already read earlier, but _read_optional_query_text(args.plan_file) reads the same file again, causing unnecessary double I/O and parsing.

  WHY: The patch does not intercept the file-read API actually used by the read-fallback path, so it cannot detect that regression.
